verses.text: For the sake of Zion I will not keep silent. For the sake of Jerusalem I will not rest until her righteousness shines out like the dawn, and her salvation like a blazing torch.
The nations will see your righteousness, and all kings will see your glory. You will be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will give you.
You will be a beautiful crown in the LORD's hand, a royal crown in the hand of your God.

You will no longer be called Abandoned, and your land will no longer be called Empty. Instead, you will be called Hephzibah, which means My Delight Is in Her, and your land Beulah, which means Married. For the LORD delights in you, and your land will be married.
As a young man marries a young woman, so your sons will marry you. As a bridegroom celebrates over his bride, so your God will celebrate over you.
I have posted watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent, day or night. You who remind the LORD of his promises, do not rest,
and do not let him rest until he sets up Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

The LORD has made a promise by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "I will never again give your grain as food to your enemies. Foreigners will never again drink the new wine you worked so hard for.
But those who harvest the grain will eat it and praise the LORD. Those who gather the grapes will drink the wine in the courts of my holy place."
Go through, go through the gates! Prepare the way for the people! Build up, build up the highway! Clear away the stones! Raise a flag for the nations!
Look, the LORD has announced to the ends of the earth: "Tell the daughter of Zion, 'Look, your Savior is coming! Look, his reward is with him, and his payment comes with him.'"
They will be called The Holy People, The People Rescued by the LORD. And you will be called The City People Look For, The City No Longer Abandoned.
